newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: One killed when plane hits apartments near Zurich.
newsitem.headline: One killed when plane hits apartments near Zurich.

text.p: A pilot was killed and another person badly hurt when a light aircraft crashed into an apartment block near Zurich Airport in the suburb of Kloten on Thursday night, Swiss police said.
Police on Friday said the 54-year-old unnamed pilot, who at first survived the impact, had died of his injuries. The other man, aged 24, was critically injured. Both were Swiss nationals.

The top apartment was unoccupied at the time and none of the building's other residents were hurt, although firefighters had to put out flames that broke out in the building, which houses several families.
An airport spokesman said the twin-engine 10-seat Cessna was coming from the Swiss city of Basle when it ploughed into the rooftop shortly after 9 p.m. (1900 GMT) on approach to Zurich Airport.
